title: chore(release): cut v0.12.1 — changelog synthesis since the v0.12.0 cut, after #3173 lands
body:

## Background

Companion to the `cut-idd-template-0-12-1` roadmap. `v0.12.0` was cut
by issue `#3120` and tagged by issue `#3121`. Since the `v0.12.0` tag,
`main` has moved 158 commits / 24 merged pull requests as of
2026-09-22, with issue `#3173` still in flight. `CHANGELOG.md`'s
`## [Unreleased]` section is empty.

Authoring survey (2026-09-22), classified by Conventional Commits
type from `git log v0.12.0..HEAD --no-merges --format='%s'`: 98
`fix`, 33 `docs`, 1 `chore`, 1 `test`, and no `feat`,
`BREAKING CHANGE:`, or `type!:` marker. The same counting method as
issue `#3120` therefore yields a patch: `0.12.1`, not `0.13.0`.
Issue `#3173` is titled `fix` and does not change that. Changelog
lede wording such as "hardening" describes this window's `fix` /
`docs` work on existing surfaces; it is not a semver-minor trigger
on its own.

The authoring request (2026-09-22) is to cut only after issue `#3173`
lands, so the changelog can capture that fix in the same entry. An
issue on that line that closes as not-planned counts as drained the
same as one that merges, since `discover-readiness-check` blocks only
on an `OPEN` referenced issue.

Blocked by #3173

Refs #3120, #3121, #3119 (non-blocking).

## Proposed change

1. Re-survey `git log v0.12.0..HEAD --no-merges --format='%s'` at
   implementation time and record type counts plus any breaking marker
   in the pull request description. Keep `0.12.1` when the counts
   still show no `feat` and no `BREAKING CHANGE:` / `type!:` marker.
   Additional `fix` / `docs` / `chore` commits, including issue
   `#3173`, stay on `0.12.1`. If a `feat` commit or a breaking marker
   has appeared, stop and report rather than bumping to `0.13.0` or a
   major in this issue.
2. Bump `iddVersion` in `.github/idd/config.json` and
   `idd-template/.github/idd/config.json`, and the `version` field in
   `package.json`, to `0.12.1` (keep all three in lockstep --
   `tests/consistency.test.mts`'s version-alignment check pins this).
3. Replace the empty `## [Unreleased]` section with a dated
   `0.12.1` `CHANGELOG.md` entry synthesizing the first-parent window
   since `v0.12.0` as user-facing highlights under Added / Changed /
   Fixed, at the `[0.12.0]` entry's granularity -- not a raw pull
   request dump. Use the starting draft below; fold in anything that
   landed after the 2026-09-22 survey. After issue `#3173` closes,
   re-word its bullet from the landed pull request, or drop that
   bullet if the issue closed without a merge. Do not ship the
   placeholder wording unchanged if the merge differs.
4. Update live (non-historical) `v0.12.0` / `0.12.0` pins that should
   track the current template version, including onboarding blob URLs
   under `idd-template/docs/onboarding/`. Leave historical
   `CHANGELOG.md` entries and third-party lockfiles alone, including
   `pnpm-lock.yaml`'s unrelated `engines.node >=0.12.0` constraint.
   Those blob URLs 404 until the companion tag track pushes
   `v0.12.1`; that is the established playbook.
5. Point the implementing pull request at the companion tag-push
   child as the required post-merge step.

### Starting CHANGELOG draft (2026-09-22 survey)

Treat this as a starting draft. Re-survey at implementation time.
The issue `#3173` bullet is a placeholder only: re-word it from the
landed change, or omit it if that issue closed without a merge.

```markdown
## [0.12.1] - YYYY-MM-DD

Claim and worktree takeover fixes, review and marker-family
fixes, and instruction-precision patch since the 0.12.0 cut.

### Added

- `live-status-digest` gains a maintainer-gated repair path for
  duplicate live-status digest comments (#3158).

### Changed

- README banner and production metrics (3,000+ issues / 1,400+
  merged pull requests) (PR `#3123`).
- The Biome lint gate now fails on new warnings (#3124).
- Lite instruction files close remaining critique-loop mirroring
  gaps: resolve `critiqueLoop.delegate` during E10, and invoke the
  C2/C4 critique telemetry hook (#3129, #3127).
- Documentation precision across merge (F2/F3 dirty-HEAD
  `reset --hard` guard, F4 cwd-before-worktree-removal, cleanup
  evidence re-check before POST), work (WorkTrunk `-x` noop `cd`,
  preserve test exit status), claim (refuse new claims during
  context-pressure exit), resume (inherited-commit scope audit
  before sections W7/W8/FH), review-triage (paginate E4
  `userContentEdits`), CI (`gh api` jq argument boundaries), and
  issue-authoring (`|set|==1` self-anchor fast-path).

### Fixed

- Claim, worktree, and discover: skip live local worktrees during
  stale takeover, close unattended worktree takeover gaps, and
  require local ownership evidence before resume (#3141).
- Resume: route empty required-check sets through present-run CI
  (#3145).
- Discover: accept canonical issue-number flags across candidate
  helpers (#3143).
- Review: classify CodeRabbit already-reviewed acknowledgements,
  and count Copilot reviews rather than watermark posts for
  `deferAfterRounds` (#3146, #3162).
- Marker helpers: register `zero-accepted-path-a-gate` as
  operational, and scope authoring-marker supersede classification
  to (family, target identity) rather than family alone (#3159,
  #3167).
- `resolved-decision`: tolerate a hard-wrapped line break after
  the inline Maintainer-decision colon (#3165).
- `authoring-owner-provenance`: detect body edits via GraphQL
  `lastEditedAt` rather than REST `updatedAt`, so a
  hide-on-supersede minimize no longer fails a Stage 1 acquire as
  edited (issue `#3173`; placeholder -- re-word from the landed
  PR, or omit if it closed without a merge).
- Source-repo `token-cost` harvest reports unclosed phase-event
  windows (#3155).
```

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `iddVersion` in `.github/idd/config.json` and
      `idd-template/.github/idd/config.json`, and `package.json`
      `version`, all equal `0.12.1`.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a dated `0.12.1` section covering the
      `v0.12.0..HEAD` first-parent window at `[0.12.0]` highlight
      granularity, and `## [Unreleased]` is empty above it. After
      issue `#3173` closes, that section either contains a bullet
      re-worded from the landed pull request or omits `#3173` if
      the issue closed without a merge.
- [ ] The candidate files listed below contain no live
      (non-historical) `0.12.0` / `v0.12.0` template-version pin.
      Historical `CHANGELOG.md` entries and `pnpm-lock.yaml`'s
      `engines.node >=0.12.0` constraint stay unchanged.
- [ ] `pnpm test`, `node scripts/audit-docs.mjs --check`, and
      `pnpm run lint` all pass.
- [ ] The implementing pull request description records the
      implementation-time commit-type survey and references the
      companion tag-push issue as the required post-merge step.

## Candidate files

- `CHANGELOG.md`
- `package.json`
- `.github/idd/config.json`
- `idd-template/.github/idd/config.json`
- `idd-template/docs/onboarding/agent-entry-and-verification.md`
- `idd-template/docs/onboarding/issue-mediated-bootstrap.md`
- `idd-template/docs/onboarding/optional-host-setup.md`
- `idd-template/docs/onboarding/project-tuning.md`

---

_Autopilot suitability: 3 / 5 -- higher is more autopilot-suitable;
below the configured floor is human-oriented. The version bump and
lockstep checks are mechanical; the changelog synthesis needs
editorial judgment at the `[0.12.0]` entry's granularity, including
re-wording the still-in-flight issue `#3173` bullet._
